text.zh: 在國立彰化生活美學館與國美館館長陳貺怡對談「天地之美，心源之境」，談水墨的傳承、轉化與心靈表現。
text.en: A public conversation with Chen Kuang-yi, Director of the National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts, at the National Changhua Living Art Center, on tradition, transformation, and the inner life of ink painting.

text.zh: 《天地有大美》2026 袁之靜水墨創作展開幕！63 件新作首度公開，展期至 11 月 1 日，國立彰化生活美學館第一、二展覽室。
text.en: “The Great Beauty of Heaven and Earth” is open: 63 new works, on view through November 1 at the National Changhua Living Art Center, Galleries 1 & 2.
